candidate_name: Singapore LNG Terminal Phase 4 expansion (5th tank)
current_state: Design provision only. SLNG's existing Jurong Island terminal is built with provisions for a possible future Phase 4 expansion, to be considered 'at a later stage should demand support the investment.' SLNG market-tested demand for a 5th storage tank back in Dec 2018; no formal proposal, FEED, EPC, or FID since.
missing_threshold_elements: Concrete step taken (no FEED/permit/FID/site-commitment beyond pre-built design provision; purely contingent on future demand).
watch_for: An SLNG announcement converting the Phase 4 provision into a funded project (FEED award, EPC tender, or 5th-tank FID). Would be a new unit on the existing Singapore LNG Terminal (T100000130309), not a new terminal.
notes: Below the discovery threshold; logged so it is not re-discovered each batch. Route to UPDATE as a new unit on the existing operating terminal if/when it firms up.
